marathon.name: Verdi
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Verdi! I'm a fun loving lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home, and let me tell you - I'm a little picky! I'm a diva, and I'm not afraid to say it. I'm not a big fan of being picked up or held, but will curl up in your lap on my own terms - I just like to be in charge. I love to be spoiled and would be best as an only pet. If you think I could be the diva of my dreams then come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Ryn
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ryn! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a very loving girl but I can be a little shy with new people. Not much is known about me before I came to HSMC as I was a stray but staff do know I have a rather unique look to me. As you can tell, one of my pupils are very different than the other. Don't worry though, I'm still very active, playful and loving! It doesn't change a single thing about me. If you think I could be the gal for you come visit me soon!*Ryn is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Ryn please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Boombastic *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: I'm a mouser in need of a job, you got mice? I'll get them!

marathon.name: Argus *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Argus and I'm a working cat. You won't find me cuddled up on the couch with the family, I'll be at the edge of the shadows practicing my independence and keeping the rodent population under control. The best part? You can pay me in the form of food, water and shelter.

marathon.name: Lily
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Lily! I'm a sweet gal that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I was found wandering the fields with three friends of mine and were rescued by a kind family that helped me. But, after escaping a few times and thinking that chickens were yummy it was decided my previous owners weren't coming forward and it was time for me to find a new place to call home, so here I am! I'm a very loving girl and I love snuggles and being around people. If you think I could be the sweetheart for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Davion
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Davion! I'm a happy guy that is here at HSMC after being found as a stray. I'm a loving guy that loves people and snacks! I'm very mellow and sweet so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Crabbe
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Crabbe but I promise I'm not crabby. I'm a sweet little guy that originally came to HSMC as a stray. I was very scared and upset at first but now I realized all the staff here are just helping me find my forever home! I'm active, playful and just perfectly cute if I say so myself. If you think a guy like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Raven
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Raven! I'm a sweet girl that is patiently waiting here for my new family to find me. I'm a playful gal that loves my toys, people and snuggles! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Robert
marathon.bio: Are you ready to solve a mystery? I'm Robert and I'm trying to solve the mystery of why I'm not adopted yet! I'm a sweet boy that had arrived to HSMC as a stray but I'm ready to find a new place to call home. I may be a little shy when you first meet me but soon I know we will be the best of friends! I would thrive in a home with other cats as they really help me with my confidence! I hope you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Atticus
marathon.bio: Howdy partners! My name is Atticus and I am excited about EVERYTHING! I've got a lot of laughs and energy to share so hold on tight and let's goooo! Dog friends are a must have in my book, as are belly rubs, sunshine and Pup-Peroni treats. I can't wait to be best friends!

marathon.name: Ruby
marathon.bio: The world can be a big and scary place, especially for a nervous girl like me. My name is Ruby and I'm looking for an adult only home where I can be the only pet; I know that makes things complicated as most households have children or other pets, but I've got a feeling that the right person is out there for me, somewhere. I'm a smart girl (too smart for my own good sometimes) and I don't give my heart away easily but once you have it, it will be yours forever. I'd love for you to talk to staff about my past life and what I'm looking for in my future and maybe, if things go right, the things we need are one and the same.

marathon.name: Ginny
marathon.bio: Hello there, my name is Ginny. My namesake might be good at bat bogey hexes, but I am more of a lover than a fighter. Come down and meet me, you won't need a bottle of Amortencia to fall in love with me. I just need a bit of your patience to let me warm up to you. I will be waiting at the shelter to meet you.

marathon.name: Catalytic Converter
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Catalytic Converter and boy am I ready to drive on home with you! I'm a super sweet kitten that loves people, toys and snugglin'. Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Lantern *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Are you looking for a light to guide you into taking care of your mouse problem? Well, I'm Lantern and I will show you the way! Come adopt me as your barn cat!

marathon.name: Garfield
marathon.bio: Hello, my name is Garfield. I don't know yet if I like lasagna but I can tell you I like chin scritches and being brushed. I am a quite guy with one of those faces you just have to love. Come down and let's explore the lasagna, or maybe just some cat kibble, together.*Garfield is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Garfield please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Hannah *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Hannah! I'm a quiet gal that is here with my best friend, Buddy, looking for our new home together! I'm a sweet girl that takes a little time to warm up, but once I do we will be the best of friends! Buddy is more confidant and outgoing but I know that we balance each other out perfectly! You can bet the two of us will be stuck like glue in our new home and we just can't wait for you to adopt us!

marathon.name: Conductor
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Conductor! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC waiting for you to adopt me! I'm very active, talkative and ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Cassette
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Cassette and I'm ready to provide the soundtrack to your new life! I'm a great cat that loves people, a quiet nap in the afternoon and even other cats. If you think a calm gal like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Vulpix
marathon.bio: Vulpix, I choose YOU! Yes, I'm Vulpix and I'm ready for my new trainer to come find me. I'm a great girl that loves attention, exploring, snuggling and just being around people! I came to HSMC as a stray but I'm ready to commit to a new forever. If you think a gorgeous girl like me could be the one for you come visit me today!

marathon.name: Kimmi Kae
marathon.bio: Hi! I'm Kimmi Kae and I'm so excited to meet you! Are you going to adopt me? I'm a totally purrfect feline that loves to play, snuggle and I even love other cats! Doesn't that just make you think I'm purrfect? Well, it's settled you need to come adopt me! See you soon!

marathon.name: Fried Pickles
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm everyone's favorite appetizer, Fried Pickles! I'm a sweet girl that is here looking for a new place to call home. I'm active, gorgeous and super playful! I'd be a great fit in a home with other cats as I love to play and run! I'd also make a good fit in a home with kids and maybe even a dog. If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Kallie Jo
marathon.bio: Kallie Jo here, I am ready for you to hurry up with the paperwork and come and adopt me. Let's not waste any time and let the adventures begin. I'm up for anything, a walk or swim or hike, we have the future together and we can do it all. I am a young, happy, energetic girl. I love to play with toys; I especially love to play BALL! I love to play in the water... typical Lab, right? I love other dogs, but I can play a little rough, so I'll have to find dogs who can match my level of play. Well, come on down and meet me!

marathon.name: Vixie
marathon.bio: Hey there, my name is Vixie. I arrived by police car to HSMC, don't worry I didn't break any laws, they just gave me a ride. You may have noticed by looking at my photos, I am a little on the heavier side. It is important that my adopter understands how unhealthy this is for me and can help me on a weight loss journey to hel me be healthier in the future. I've met both dogs and cats in the shelter and did well with both. I enjoy spending time outside, walks and a little play time with toys. So, what do you say, should we do this adoption thing?

marathon.name: Majora
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Majora! I'm a sweet little lady that is here at HSMC hoping to find my new home real soon. I'm a goofy gal that loves to play with her toys and that will make a great fit in just about any home. If you think you could be the family for me come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Space Cat *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Space Cat and I'm ready to land on your home planet to catch all of those pesky mice! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Knox
marathon.bio: All around me are dogs who are at different stages of acclimating to shelter life; some are brave and make it look easy and some are just trying to right the world that has been turned upside down. Here's the thing, I'm having a hard time. The people I used to love, the dog I used to be, the life I used to know; all of that's gone and I've had to start over new. I tell you this so that you know to take things slow and give me grace when we meet; I've never had to do this before. I'm a loyal and independent girl who would prefer to be the only pet in a quiet household. I need only a few things but very consistently; food/water, love and exercise. Maybe you too have been through a difficult time and felt misunderstood? I'm hoping you're the person who can give me everything that I need and that I may return the favor, too.Less

marathon.name: Galaxy *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Galaxy and I want to be as untamed and free as the universe itself. I'm used to a life on the streets taking care of me, myself and I. I'd be happy to be your barn or shop cat if you'll have me!

marathon.name: Grease
marathon.bio: HI, I'm Grease! Do you like taking nice long walks? Well, so do I! I'm leash trained and ready to go on lots of adventures with YOU! I'm a great cat that would be purrfect in a home with other cats and kids. I'm super outgoing and loving so you better come adopt me before someone else does!

marathon.name: Boombox
marathon.bio: Hiya, I'm Boombox and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a playful guy that loves other cats, kids and even dogs! I'm super outgoing and goofy so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Chocolate
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Chocolate! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new home! I'm outgoing, snuggly and so adorable! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Kabuto
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Kabuto! I'm a sweet boy that is here at HSMC looking to find my new home! I'm super outgoing, loving and oh so affectionate! Come see me soon!

marathon.name: Cheesy Fry
marathon.bio: Hiya, I'm Cheesy Fry! I'm a fun loving gal that is hoping and waiting eagerly for my new family! I'm a great cat that loves people, kids and other cats! I love to play with my toys and I have lots of energy and love to give! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Rufus
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Rufus! I'm a happy go lucky guy that wandered my way to HSMC as a stray. I'm a sweet boy that loves everyone I meet and that includes other dogs! I would love a family that loves to go on walks or runs, camping, hiking, swimming, or whatever! I just want a family! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Triforce
marathon.bio: Triforce here, are you ready to face your past and your future by adopting me? Well, let's go! I'm a fun loving feline that will guide you into having the very best life ever! I'm playful, fun loving and ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!*Triforce is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Triforce please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Skull Kid
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Skull Kid! I'm kind of one of those shy, hidden side characters that most people glance right past, but if you get to know me you will just how loving and sweet I can be! I'm a friendly guy that loves playing with my siblings, toys and just being around the people I love! Come visit me soon!*Skull Kid is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Skull Kid please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Record Player
marathon.bio: Hiya! Looking for some sweet music to introduce into your life? Well, I'm Record Player and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a super adorable kitten that is here at HSMC looking for a new family. I was brought to the shelter as a teeny tiny kitten so I went to stay with my foster mom, Grandma. She took great care of me until it was time for me to find my forever family. Grandma says I can be a bit of a wild child as I love to race around, play with my toys and explore all over! I hardly sit still! I'd be great with kids, other cats and even dogs! Grandma had something called a 'pug' that would come try to steal my food, he was funny! Anyways, I'm pretty much the purrfect package! Come meet me soon!

marathon.name: Magnet
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Magnet and boy have I been patiently waiting to find a new family. I'm a gentle but shy guy who isn't always confident and brave around new people but I'm trying my very best. I'm hoping to find a kind human who accepts my social anxiety and loves me for who I am. A quiet household full of patience, love and pets would be a dream come true. You'll find me at Animal House Pet Care in Kronenwetter!

marathon.name: Terracotta
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Terracotta! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC as a stray. I'm a great cat that loves attention but can be a little shy until I get to know you! Come visit me soon!*Terracotta is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Terracotta please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Sassy
marathon.bio: Where are all of my strong, independent girlies at? My name is Sassy and it fits; I like to keep my inner circle small and would prefer to be your one and only. I've had my fair share of homes and transitions so I'm hoping to find the one that sticks. Adventurous adults are my vibe, small children or dogs that share my home not so much. I know my forever is out there and I just can't wait to find it.

marathon.name: Plant Stand *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: They call me Plant Stand because I'm multi-purpose and sturdy, ready to get the job done. I was born outside and intended to stay there until I was caught in a live trap and brought to the shelter. I long to get back to the great outdoors where I can hunt and be free. I'd be happy to be your shop or barn cat and will even work for free!

marathon.name: Ignotus
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ignotus! I'm a fun loving feline that is hoping to make you fall in love with me! I'm active, playful and oh so cute! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Blu
marathon.bio: My name is Blu and I'm looking for a fresh start. My life has taken some unexpected turns and I'm in the camp that says it's about the destination and not journey. Here's to hoping that all of the roads I've traveled thus far will lead me straight to you. I'm a smart and confident guy who is selective when it comes to other dogs and should not be placed with small dogs or cats. I know a handful of tricks that I'll gladly show you in exchange for a treat and I'm looking forward to the long walks and talks we'll share. I can't wait to love everything about you.

marathon.name: Times New Roman
marathon.bio: Hey there, are you looking for the purrfect font to add to your home? Well, I'm Times New Roman and I'm a classic! I'm a fun loving feline that loves people, playing with toys and goofing around with other cats! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Frosty
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Frosty! I'm a fancy feline that was brought to HSMC as a stray and am now looking for a forever home. I'm super sweet, soft and I love other cats! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Valestin
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Valestin! I'm a handsome guy that wandered his way into HSMC after going on an adventure. I've decided it's time to settle down and find a family to call my own, so please adopt me! I'm playful, outgoing and ready to be yours! Let's adventure together!

marathon.name: Florean
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Florean! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I arrived to the shelter as a stray but I'm ready to leave with my new family! I'm outgoing, soft and ready to be YOURS!*Florean is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Florean please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Buddy *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Buddy! My best pal, Hannah, and I are here at HSMC looking for our new home! We're a great pair that are both very mellow and quiet. I love to get pets and scritches, and Hannah likes a little more alone time but we sure love each other! You will always catch us snuggling or grooming each other. If you think a gorgeous pair like us could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Tata
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Tata! I'm a sweet little lady that is ready to say tata to HSMC when I get adopted. I'm a quiet gal that would be purrfect in just about any home. I had originally come to the shelter as a stray so I'm soooo ready to get out of here with a new family! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Stack
marathon.bio: I just can't get why my case is still unsolved? Why am I not adopted yet? I'm Stack and I'm ready and willing to be adopted RIGHT NOW. I can be a little shy, sure, but who isn't when you're meeting strangers. I love other cats and I know I'll soon blossoming into an amazing feline. Please adopt me right now!

marathon.name: Hosea *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: If you're looking for a working cat, I'm your guy! My name is Hosea and I'm used to a life on the streets and fending for myself, relying on the kindness of strangers to get by. Don't get me wrong, I still want the independence but I'd like someone lookin' out for me too. I'll gladly call your shop or barn my home and I'm sure we can figure out the rest of the details from there.

marathon.name: Chewy
marathon.bio: Hey friends! They call me Chewy and tell me that I'm a good boy and I'm sure hoping that you feel the same way, too. I've got beautiful blue eyes, a stubborn streak and the smarts and wit common to my breed. I enjoy spending time outside, playing fetch and singing the songs of my people. I'm tolerant of other dogs but do not want to share treats or high value items. You look like you could be a forever kind of human, let's make my dreams come true!

marathon.name: Misa
marathon.bio: You look like someone who likes to have FUN and well, that's one thing we already have in common! My name is Misa and I'm looking for a place to call home and a family to love. I'm a high energy girl who is ready to take the world by storm. I'm selective when it comes to other dogs (but my bestie Remi is here and I like her) and may be a bit much for a home with cats. I love feeling the fresh air in my fur and having my favorite human at my side. See you soon?

marathon.name: Post Office *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Looking to find a new mouser for your home? I could be the one for YOU!

marathon.name: CD
marathon.bio: Hiya, are you ready to find your new favorite record? Well, I'm CD and I'm here to wow you! I'm an adorable kitten that is so playful, snuggly and just generally puuuuuurrfect! I'm great with other cats, kids and dogs so you better come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Sidon
marathon.bio: Hey there, I bet you're wondering who this handsome guy is? Well, I'm Sidon and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a fun loving guy that is here just waiting and waiting for you to adopt me! You better do so soon! I'm great with other cats and would be excellent in a home with them again! Come visit me soon!*Sidon is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Sidon please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Bevvy
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Bevvy! I'm a shy girl here at HSMC that is hoping to find a home to call my very own. Don't be surprised if it takes me a little bit to warm up to you, I haven't always been able to trust humans but the staff here have been showing me that I can. I'm a sweet girl that enjoys being brushed and pet. I especially love a little canned cat food in the morning! Come visit me soon if you think I could be the cat for you!

marathon.name: Misha
marathon.bio: Hi, I'm Misha and if you ask me, I'm the coolest cat here at HSMC (don't tell Butterscotch I said that)! I have a head tremor but it's something I live with and I think it makes me special; I'm hoping you'll see it that way, too. I have a lot of energy and a lot of love to share with my new family- here's to hoping I fall in love with someone like Y-O-U!**I'm Feline Leukemia Positive, please ask staff for more information!**

marathon.name: Brinkley
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Brinkley! I'm a shy gal that is here hoping someone is looking for a sweet girl like me. I came to HSMC as a stray and while I'm very sweet, it takes me a little time to trust. But once we're friends I will be the cuddliest girl you will ever meet. I sure hope you like me!

marathon.name: Glamma
marathon.bio: My name is Glamma, I found my way to HSMC as a stray. I'm glad I found my way here because the streets are no place for a girl like me. In all honesty, the shelter isn't a place for an old girl like me either. I belong in a home with my own people to love and my own bed to sleep in and a little toy basket with all of my favorite toys. I deserve to have my very own leash and collar with a little ID tag with my name and owner's phone number on it. I'll be here dreaming about the day that I get to have all of those things. If you are willing to open your heart to love a senior girl like me, please come and meet me.

marathon.name: Widow
marathon.bio: My name is Widow and I'm so easy to love. I'm sweet, petite and more than qualified to be your new bestie. I'm gentle and submissive which makes me a great catch for a family with other pets (cats or dogs) or children. I'd be hard pressed to tell you what I like more between tennis balls and belly rubs, so hopefully you'll give me plenty of both. I can just keep listing all of my fantastic qualities or you could just come meet me and see for yourself!

clark.name: Darla (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: If you're looking for a dog with brains, loyalty, and a heart that's worth earning, meet Darla! Like many Heelers, Darla is incredibly intelligent and loves having a job to do. She's observant, eager to learn, and forms deep bonds with the people she trusts. Once you're part of her circle, you'll discover what a sweet, devoted companion she truly is. Darla can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up—especially around some men—but patience and kindness go a long way. She'll do best with someone who understands that trust isn't rushed, and that watching a timid dog blossom is one of life's greatest rewards. Darla is looking for an adult-only home, as she's not comfortable living with children. In the right environment, with people who respect her boundaries and appreciate her brilliant mind, she's sure to become an incredibly loyal best friend. If you're ready to invest a little time and a lot of love, Darla is ready to show you just how special she is. Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor!

clark.name: Tiny
clark.bio: Meet Tiny! Tiny came to CCHS as an owner surrender, previously set to be a barn cat however a little bit of wobble in her step had the owner bringing her over to us. This itty-bitty bashful gal is about 11 months old and weighs roughly 4.4lbs currently. Tiny is a sweet gal who is just a little unsure of things! She wasn't given a lot of socialization so she is the teeniest timid, but one thing for certain is that she looooves affection! She does not always know how to ask for it, but with a gentle touch and a little patience, she's very easy to win over. Tiny currently resides in our Kitty City with a number of other feline friends. Apply for Tiny today!

clark.name: Kiara
clark.bio: Meet Kiara! Kiara came to CCHS as a medical transfer from another humane society after her ears developed some pretty nasty infections and needed more in-depth care. This beautiful Mixed Breed is about 7 years old and weighs roughly 76.2lbs currently. Kiara is a delightfully sweet senior that is ready for a furever family of her own to live out the rest of her days with! With Kiara's ears needing some extra tending to, it is important for her to go home with a family who will stay vigilant in keeping her happy and healthy through the rest of her life. While we don't know much about this darling gal, even her breed makeup stays a mystery, we can tell you she is 100% Mayor of Snuggle City! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Kiara today!

clark.name: Connie
clark.bio: Connie has already proven she's resilient. After being abandoned in a basement with Reyn and Nana, she never gave up hope that someone would come. Today, Connie is ready to leave that chapter behind and start writing a new one filled with adventures, belly rubs, sniff-filled walks, and the unconditional love every dog deserves. She's a classic coonhound with a gentle heart and an incredible capacity to forgive. Connie is searching for a family that will cherish her, celebrate her progress, and remind her every single day that she'll never be left behind again. She's waited long enough for her happily ever after—could it be with you?

clark.name: Florence
clark.bio: Meet Florence. Florence. Florence came to us as an abandoned stray, she was pregnant when she came in. She currently weighs 5# She has had her babies and nurtured them enough to leave the nest, and now its her time to be loved and doted on! Florence is willing to accept all the back and cheek rubs offered. She is ready to become your newest addition and be the baby for a change. Apply today to show her some love!

clark.name: Reyn
clark.bio: Reyns' story didn't begin the way every dog deserves. She, along with Connie and Nana, were abandoned and left behind in a basement, relying only on each other until help finally arrived. Despite everything, Reyn hasn't let her past steal her future. She's a sweet, gentle soul whos ready to discover what it means to be someones beloved companion. Whether its following her nose on a leisurely walk, soaking up attention, or simply enjoying the comfort of a warm bed, Reyn is ready for the life shes always deserved. Shes looking for a family that understands trust takes time, but knows the reward of watching a dogs confidence bloom is worth every moment. Reyn has survived the hardest chapter of her life—now shes ready for the happiest one.

clark.name: Nana
clark.bio: For too long, Nana's world was limited to four basement walls. Abandoned alongside her companions, Reyn and Connie, she waited patiently for someone to find her—and thankfully, that day finally came. Now Nana is getting the chance to experience all the things every dog should know: kindness, security, soft beds, full bellies, and people who wont leave her behind. She's a beautiful coonhound with so much love still waiting to give to the right family. Nana doesn't need a perfect home—she just needs one that's patient, understanding, and ready to show her that forever really can mean forever. If you're looking for a loyal friend whose best days are still ahead, Nana is waiting to meet you!

clark.name: Alfie
clark.bio: Meet Alfie! This handsome young guy came to us as a stray, and while his journey hasn't been the easiest, he's proving just how resilient he is. Alfie recently underwent hip surgery and is recovering well, but he'll need a family that understands his ongoing needs and is willing to give him the time and support he deserves. Don't let that fool you into thinking he's fragile, though Alfie's favorite thing in the world is people! He loves attention, affection, and being the center of your universe. Whether he's soaking up pets, following you around, or curling up nearby, Alfie is happiest when he's with his humans. If you're looking for a loving companion and have room in your heart for a special cat who's ready for a fresh start, Alfie may be the perfect match. Apply for Alfie today!

clark.name: Rita (Bonded with Tom Tom)
clark.bio: Rita is a 4-year-old Domestic Shorthair who came in with Tom Tom and is still learning that the world and people can be safe. She is not very socialized yet and tends to be shy in new situations, preferring to observe from a distance rather than jump right into interaction. Because of her background, Rita will need a patient home that allows her to adjust at her own pace without pressure. She may take time to warm up, but with consistency and a calm environment, she has the potential to build confidence and slowly learn trust. Rita would do best in a quiet home where routines are predictable, and she can feel secure. She's not the type to demand attention, but she deserves a space where she can finally relax and just be herself. For someone willing to give her time and understanding, Rita can blossom into a quiet, steady companion.

clark.name: Tom Tom (Bonded with Rita)
clark.bio: Tom Tom is a gentle 10-year-old Domestic Shorthair who is looking for a calm, comfortable place to spend his golden years. He has some neuro and mobility concerns noted, and would do best in a home that understands he may move a little differently and appreciate life at a slower pace. He is on the shy and timid side, and hasn't had a lot of socialization, so new environments and people can feel overwhelming for him at first. With patience and consistency, he should start to settle in and show his quiet, soft personality underneath. Tom Tom isn't the kind of cat who will demand attention, but he does want comfort, safety, and a predictable routine. He would thrive in a low-traffic home where he can relax, observe, and simply be cared for without pressure. If you're looking for a low-key companion who just needs a soft landing and a kind place to land for his later years, Tom Tom may be the perfect gentle soul.

clark.name: Teller
clark.bio: Meet Teller, a brilliant young dog with a thoughtful heart and a story that's led her right back to us through no fault of her own. At just 10 months old, this Rat Terrier and Cattle Dog mix already shows off her impressive intelligence and communication skills. She even knows how to use a button to let you know when she needs to go potty! Teller was originally adopted but sadly returned due to changes in her owner's circumstances. Because of that, she can be a little slow to trust when meeting new people and adjusting to new environments. She likes to take her time observing the world and figuring out who feels safe. But once Teller decides you're her person, she truly shines. She becomes a deeply loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who sticks close and bonds hard. Her smart, attentive nature makes her an incredible partner for someone willing to give her patience and consistency. With her mix of brains, sensitivity, and heart, Teller will thrive in a calm, understanding home that lets her open up at her own pace. In return, she offers one of the most rewarding bonds you can ask for. Teller isn't just looking for a home, but is looking for someone to trust completely.

clark.name: Farquaad
clark.bio: Big personality in a little puppy package? That sounds like Farquaad! This adorable pup from our Shrek litter is ready to rule a kingdom of his own — preferably one filled with toys, treats, and lots of love. Farquaad is a playful puppy who enjoys exploring, learning new things, and soaking up attention. He'll need a family ready for the fun (and occasional chaos!) that comes with puppyhood, including training, patience, and lots of positive experiences. Farquaad's fairy-tale friends Donkey, Dragon, Fiona, Gingy, Prince Charming, and Shrek are also looking for homes, but this little guy is ready to be the star of your story.

clark.name: Shrek
clark.bio: Ogres may be known for living in swamps, but this Shrek is searching for something much better — a loving forever home! Shrek is one of the adorable pups from our Shrek litter and is ready to begin his next adventure. Shrek is a playful, curious puppy who enjoys discovering new things and spending time with his people. He's looking for a family who understands that puppies take time, training, and commitment — but give back endless love and laughter. Shrek's siblings Donkey, Dragon, Farquaad, Fiona, Gingy, and Prince Charming are all looking for homes too. This little guy doesn't need a swamp... just a family to call his own!

clark.name: Sam
clark.bio: Sam is a handsome 60-pound mixed-breed boy who came to us as a stray, and he's ready to find the loving family he deserves! This sweet, young pup has a heart as big as his smile. Sam absolutely loves playing fetch and will happily chase after a ball as many times as you're willing to throw it. When playtime is over, he's more than happy to soak up all the attention and affection you can give. Belly rubs, pets, and spending time with his people are at the top of his favorite things list. Sam's playful personality and loving nature make him a wonderful companion for someone looking for an active best friend who also enjoys plenty of cuddles. Since he came to us as a stray, we're still getting to know everything about him, but one thing is already clear—he's an incredibly sweet boy who can't wait to find a place to call home. If you're looking for a loyal companion who's always up for a game of fetch and lots of love, Sam might just be your perfect match!

clark.name: Cat-Thrine
clark.bio: Meet Cat-thrine, a sweet mama cat who has spent the last chapter of her life raising her kittens and is now ready for a new adventure of her own! Cat-thrine is the proud momma of the Coral, Cove, Pearl, Reef, and Tide kitten group. She has done an amazing job caring for her babies, but now it's her turn to be the one receiving all the love and attention. This lovely lady is ready to trade in her busy mom duties for a life filled with cozy naps, gentle affection, and a family who will cherish her. Cat-thrine is looking for a forever home where she can relax, be loved, and enjoy being more than just a mom — she can simply be a beloved companion. Could Cat-thrine be the perfect addition to your family?

clark.name: Biggie
clark.bio: Biggie may have arrived as a stray, but hes quickly showing that underneath his unsure first impressions is a big-hearted dog just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe. At around 4 years old, Biggie is past the puppy chaos but still has plenty of life, love, and personality to share. He can be a little skittish when meeting new people or experiencing new environments, but give him a bit of time and patience and youll see the transformation-soft eyes, relaxed body language, and a whole lot of affection. Once Biggie trusts you, he leans in hard for love. He enjoys gentle attention, reassurance, and simply being near his person. Hes the kind of dog who bonds deeply and becomes incredibly loyal once he knows hes safe. Biggie will do best in a calm, patient home that understands he may need a little time to decompress and adjust. In return, he offers a big personality, a big heart, and a whole lot of love just waiting to come out. If youre looking for a diamond-in-the-ruff who just needs someone to believe in him, Biggie might be your guy.

clark.name: Sharky
clark.bio: Meet Sharky, a 1-year-old Cattle Dog mix with a heart that's just waiting for the right person to help it shine. Life has left this sweet girl feeling a little uncertain, so she's very timid and shy when meeting new people and experiencing new places. Sharky isn't the kind of dog who will immediately run into your arms—but that's what makes earning her trust so special. She'll need a patient family that's willing to give her the time, love, and kindness she deserves. As she learns that the world isn't such a scary place, you'll get to watch her confidence grow a little more each day. The best things in life are worth waiting for, and Sharky is no exception. With a gentle heart and a family willing to let her settle in at her own pace, she has all the potential to blossom into an incredible companion. The day she finally chooses to lean into you for comfort or wags her tail when you walk through the door will make every bit of patience worthwhile. If you have a quiet home, a kind heart, and room for a shy girl who's ready for a fresh start, Sharky may be the one you've been waiting for.

clark.name: Rosalyn
clark.bio: Rosalyn has spent the last chapter of her life being a wonderful mom, and now that her babies are grown and ready to find families of their own, its finally Moms turn! This sweet girl has finished raising her little ones and is ready to trade her mom duties for a life filled with love, cozy naps, tasty treats, and being someones beloved companion. Shes got plenty of love left to give — she just wants a family to share it with. Rosalyn is ready to leave the mom life behind and discover all the fun that comes with being someones spoiled girl. If youve been waiting for a sweet companion to add to your family, Rosalyn would love the chance to meet you! Her babies have their bags packed and are ready for their own adventures... now Rosalyn is hoping hers is just beginning. Come meet Rosalyn and give this deserving mama the happily-ever-after shes been waiting for!

clark.name: Bubbles
clark.bio: Meet Bubbles! This gorgeous merle girl is ready to make a splash! Bubbles is a fluffy little sweetheart with an absolutely adorable face and the kind of puppy charm that is nearly impossible to resist. Shes curious about the world around her and is at the perfect age to start learning all about being a wonderful family companion. As a Chow/Aussie mix, Bubbles has the potential to grow into a smart, active girl who will love having things to do. Whether that means learning new tricks, exploring outside, playing with her people, or curling up after a busy day, shes ready for it all. Bubbles has spent her early days surrounded by her siblings, but now shes ready for the next chapter — a family of her very own! If youre looking for a fluffy, beautiful puppy who will grow right alongside you, Bubbles might just be your girl.

clark.name: Crush
clark.bio: Meet Crush! This handsome red/brown boy is one seriously lovable little dude! Crush has the fluffy coat, adorable face, and playful puppy energy that makes you want to scoop him up and take him home immediately. Like any young puppy, Crush is still learning about the world and will need a family ready to teach him all the important things — potty training, manners, confidence, and how to be the very best dog he can be. Luckily, he has plenty of time to learn and grow! His Chow/Aussie mix heritage means Crush could grow into an intelligent and active companion who will enjoy being included in his family's adventures. Walks, playtime, training sessions, and plenty of affection are all on his future wish list. Crush is ready to leave the puppy pile behind and start an adventure of his own. Dude, this could be the beginning of something awesome!

clark.name: Bowie
clark.bio: Bowie is one seriously entertaining puppy! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, playful, curious, and just a little bit crazy—in the absolute best puppy way. Bowie loves being part of the action and has never met a game he didnt want to join. Hes got plenty of puppy zoomies, plenty of goofy antics, and plenty of opinions to share. His terrier personality shines through in his confidence, enthusiasm, and determination to investigate everything around him. Bowie is looking for a family ready to embrace puppyhood in all its chaotic glory and help him grow into the wonderful dog hes meant to be. With training, exercise, and lots of love, this goofy guy is going to make someone a fantastic companion!

clark.name: Cher
clark.bio: Cher is a tiny package of terrier perfection! She's energetic, playful, goofy, and absolutely convinced that she needs to be involved in whatever is happening. Cher loves playing with her siblings and exploring her surroundings, and she has plenty of the classic terrier attitude to go along with her adorable looks. She can be silly, enthusiastic, and wonderfully puppy-ish, with enough energy to keep her future family on their toes! Cher will need a family prepared for all the fun—and work—that comes with raising a puppy, including continued training, socialization, exercise, and plenty of appropriate outlets for her energy. She's ready to bring some serious fun into someone's life!

clark.name: Cyndi
clark.bio: Cyndi is an adorable little terrier mix with enough personality for three puppies! She's playful, energetic, goofy, and always seems to have something going on. Cyndi is happiest when she's busy—playing with her siblings, exploring her surroundings, chasing toys, or getting into some kind of puppy nonsense. She has plenty of that classic terrier sass and enthusiasm and is not afraid to be loud when she has an opinion! Cyndi would thrive with a family who understands that puppies require patience, structure, training, and plenty of exercise. In return, you'll get a hilarious little companion who is sure to keep you smiling every day.

clark.name: Hendrix
clark.bio: Hendrix is a little terrier mix with a rockstar personality! He is energetic, playful, goofy, and always ready to turn the volume up to eleven. Like any good terrier puppy, Hendrix is curious about EVERYTHING. He loves to play, explore, wrestle, zoom around, and generally make sure there is never a dull moment. He's got a fun-loving personality and plenty of puppy energy that will need an outlet through play, exercise, training, and enrichment. If your idea of the perfect puppy includes a little bit of chaos, a lot of laughs, and an adorable face you can't resist, Hendrix could be your next best friend!

clark.name: Rue
clark.bio: Heeler/Chow Mix Puppy Little Rue is full of puppy charm! Rescued alongside her siblings, shes beginning her journey toward becoming a cherished family companion. Shell need plenty of positive experiences, training, and love as she grows, and shes sure to reward her family with endless affection and laughs.

clark.name: Dj catnip
clark.bio: DJ Catnip is a handsome 10-week-old orange-and-white kitten and part of our adorable Gabbys Dollhouse litter! This little guy is ready to fill his forever home with kitten zoomies, playful antics, and plenty of cuteness. He's at that wonderful kitten age where everything is exciting and every toy is an adventure! His littermates Cakey and Panda Paws already have adopters waiting for them, and now DJ Catnip is hoping his forever family will come along too. If an orange-and-white ball of kitten fun sounds like the perfect addition to your family, come meet DJ Catnip!

clark.name: Munchkin
clark.bio: Munchkin is a sweet little tabby-and-white kitten who is part of our adorable Gabbys Dollhouse litter! At just 10 weeks old, she's at the perfect age to discover the world, play with toys, and show off her kitten personality. Munchkin is curious, playful, and ready to find a family of her very own. She came in with her littermates Cakey and Panda Paws, who already have adopters waiting for them, so now it's Munchkin's turn to find her happily ever after! If you're looking for a tiny tabby companion to add some fun and kitten chaos to your life, Munchkin may be your girl!

clark.name: Bear
clark.bio: Meet Bear, a 1 year-old Australian Shepherd mix with a stunning coat and beautiful coloring that are sure to catch your eye. But as gorgeous as he is on the outside, his greatest potential lies in the loving companion he's waiting to become. Bear has taken a little longer than his siblings to settle into shelter life. New people and new environments can be overwhelming for him, so he's looking for a patient family that understands that trust takes time. While he may not be the first dog to run up and greet you, every small step he takes is a huge victory—and incredibly rewarding to witness. With consistency, kindness, and a little patience, Bear continues to grow more confident every day. He deserves a home where he can relax, learn that he's safe, and finally let his true personality shine. Once he realizes he's home, there's no doubt this handsome boy will become a loyal and devoted best friend. If you're looking for a dog whose love is earned through patience and understanding, Bear may be the perfect addition to your family. Sometimes the dogs who take a little longer to come around end up leaving the biggest paw prints on your heart.

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: My adoption fee is only $25 for the month of July!The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it.This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up.She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin.She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you?Less

adams.name: Magnus
adams.bio: Hi, I'm Magnus! I'm a 5-year-old Jack Russell Terrier mix with a striking white and black coat, and I'm already neutered and ready to go home with you. I'm friendly, gentle, and learning to walk well on a leash. I come as part of a bonded pair with my shy friend Ziggy, so you'll get double the love and companionship! I would do best in an adult-only home where I can thrive and help Ziggy work on his confidence. Come meet us and discover why we're the perfect package for you!

adams.name: Prue
adams.bio: My adoption fee is only $85 for the month of July!

adams.name: Ziggy
adams.bio: I'm Ziggy, a 3-year-old brown and white Jack Russell Terrier mix, and I'm a gentle soul who takes a little time to warm up to new people. I'm already neutered, so I'm ready to start fresh with you. I'm bonded with my shelter friend Magnus and we'd love to stay together — we're a package deal! I do best in a calm, adult-only home where I can build confidence at my own pace. If you're patient and kind, I promise I'll show you just how loyal and loving I can be.

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee.Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside.Much sleeping is had. And snacks.Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her.And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods!Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it.Then, after food smells (someti

fetch.name: Russell
fetch.bio: I’M FREE! After 10 months in a small cage, I’m finally out and learning what it means to be a puppy. WOOHOO!I’m Russell, and I’m ready to make up for lost time. I’m looking for an active, patient family with another dog to run and play with — bonus points for a fenced yard where I can really let loose.I’m doing great with house training, and I’m working on my leash manners and getting comfortable in my crate. Now that I’ve discovered toys (and, okay, also magazines ), I’m all about chewing, playing, and exploring everything I missed out on.I’ve got a lot of energy and I’m eager to learn — I just need you to help me burn it off with walks, runs, and plenty of stimulation.Think we could be a match? Apply for me — I’m Russell, and I can’t wait to meet you!You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet?Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for.Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love.One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required.Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard.Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. He'll thrive with a family that allows him to adjust at his own pace and celebrates the little victories along the way. Watching him gain confidence is incredibly rewa

fetch.name: Caesar
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Meet Caesar! Caesar is a big, lovable boy with an even bigger heart. This handsome Mastiff/Great Dane/Lab/Pit mix tips the scales at 88 lbs — but don’t let his size fool you. He’s a gentle giant who gets along beautifully with kids, dogs, cats, and people of all kinds.Caesar comes fully ready for his forever home: neutered, up-to-date on all vaccinations (including kennel cough), house trained, and crate trained. No medical or behavioral concerns — just a sweet, well-rounded pup looking for someone to love.He’s got a moderate-to-high energy level, so he’d thrive with a family that enjoys walks, playtime, or just an active lifestyle. He does tend to be a little cautious around men at first, but with patience and consistency, he warms right up. He just wants to know he’s safe — and once he does, he’ll be your most loyal companion.If you’re looking for a big, beautiful, good-natured dog who fits right into family life, Caesar might just be your perfect match. Apply today — we have a feeling it’ll be love at first sight. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Reggie (10)
fetch.bio: Hey everyone, my name is Reggie. Yep, I’m one of the beagles rescued from a medical testing facility, but I don’t want you to adopt me because you feel sorry for me. I want you to adopt me because you understand that I’m not looking backward anymore—I’m starting over.Will I come with some obstacles to overcome? Absolutely. But honestly, who doesn’t?I’m a very smart, inquisitive guy who loves learning new things. I’m also pretty food motivated, which makes training fun for both of us. I’m a sensitive soul who needs time, love and patience. I need someone who won’t give up on me during the hard days, the hard weeks, or even the hard months. All I want is a family that will love me forever. Now about those obstacles. Because I grew up in kennel in that place, and so did my mom, I never learned how to be a dog in a world I didn't know existed. While my foster mom says I’m making great progress I will still need some help with stuff like potty training, (Although my foster mom says I’m doing very good so far) some separation anxiety and wanting to keep all my bones and toys to myself. Oh, and because growing up in a Kennel wasn't any fun, I really have no desire to ever hang out in one again and I will be sure let you know if you try. My foster mom lets me hang out in her office with a gate in the door and while I’m still not a huge fan, its better than a kennel. My foster mom said it took me about a week to get over a lot of the stress of moving in with her family. After a while

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Hi, I'm Turbo, but don't let the name fool you! I'm currently accepting applications for the position of 'Permanent Human Companion'. My qualifications include: expert-level napping skills (especially on the couch), a strong work ethic when it comes to belly rubs, and a proven ability to make you laugh with my dramatic snorts and dramatic sighs. Dislikes include: sudden loud noises, riding in the car, being left out of the snack loop, and having my naps interrupted. Strengths: cuddles, loyalty, and a healthy appreciation for naps. I'm looking for a home with a comfy couch, a reliable source of treats, and a human who understands that sometimes, a dog just needs to be left alone (to nap, of course)."You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Frito
fetch.bio: Meet Frito — that’s right, like the snack you can’t get enough of! Same goes for this sweet 7-year-old Goldendoodle girl, who’s ready to leave her past behind and start the life she’s always deserved. After spending the beginning of her life in a commercial breeding program, she’s discovering that the world is full of kindness, cozy beds, gentle pets, and exciting new adventures.She’s currently working on her potty training and making great progress every day. She’s a snuggle bug now that she’s figured out these two-legged folks just want to love her, and she walks like a champ on a leash. Like any dog adjusting to a brand-new life, she’ll need patience, consistency, and lots of encouragement as she continues learning her house manners — no more counter surfing, garbage raids, or surprise run-ins with the patio door!This happy, curious girl is full of life and has so much love to give. Whether she’s exploring new trails, playing in the yard, or curling up beside her favorite person, she’s eager to experience all the wonderful moments she’s been waiting for and show you her personality.If you’re looking for a loyal companion and are ready to help her continue blossoming into the confident, loving dog she’s meant to be, Frito can’t wait to meet you. Her new adventure is just beginning — could it be with you?You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Twinkle
fetch.bio: Meet Twinkle Twinkle is a sweet girl who is just beginning her journey of discovering what it's like to be a beloved family pet. She is learning that the world can be a safe and happy place filled with belly rubs, couches to lay on, and lots of love.Twinkle is making great progress with house and potty training and will thrive with a patient family willing to continue helping her learn. She is still coming out of her shell is a little shy at first, but every day she becomes a little more confident.One thing Twinkle knows for sure is that she loves other dogs! Her happiest moments are spent running, playing, and exploring outside. A secure fenced yard is her dream, and having another playful, confident dog in the home would help her continue to build confidence and show her the ropes.Twinkle currently lives with children and is doing well with them. Because she is still learning to trust and adjust to family life, she will need an understanding home that will let her settle in at her own pace.If you're looking for a gentle soul to nurture and watch blossom into the dog she was always meant to be, Twinkle may be the perfect addition to your family. With patience, love, and a canine companion by her side, this special girl is sure to shine. Twinkle's Ideal Home:Another friendly, playful dog (unknown on how she is with cats)A secure fenced yardA patient family willing to continue her training and socializationA loving home that understands she may need time to adjust and potty tr

fetch.name: Walter
fetch.bio: Hey! I’m Walter! I’ve been with Fetch for awhile now, and I’m STILL looking for my forever family. Let me reintroduce myself: I’m a happy boy who likes to be a part of what’s going on. Whether we’re making dinner, you’re showering, or doing laundry - doesn’t matter to me as long as we’re together. I can supervise any project you got goin on! I am always excited to show you what I have. I am kennel/crate trained and I know to do my business outside! I’m strong, like you can tell I work out and all that. I know how to walk nicely on a leash but sometimes I seriously forget it’s even attached, this nose of mine is soooo powerful it’s crazy. I am special, my foster mom says it all the time. Just to make sure I get enough love and attention, it would be best if I am the only “good boy” in my forever home. I run like a graceful rhino and my white hair is so silky soft you won’t be able to resist loving on me. I have gotten myself into a couple situations and I really want to leave my troubled past behind me and move forward with people who get me. People who know tell me that I need structure and leadership: if you let me be the pack leader, I will take advantage of that situation. I love training and learning, my foster mom is kick butt cool at it, she has lots more information for you since I am sooo special, so apply and let’s get this party started!

fetch.name: Daisy
fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! Therfore, we would LOVE a home together if possible. We do well with older children, and we even have cats at our foster home! We like to play with our foster siblings and LOVE walks. We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Scooter (9)
fetch.bio: Meet Scooter! This handsome 1-year-old Beagle is looking for a patient adopter who will give him the time he needs to feel safe and loved. While he can be a little shy when meeting new people, especially men, once he trusts you, his sweet personality shines through. He'll happily follow you around the house, snuggle up for cuddles, and become your loyal best friend.Scooter loves being outdoors and enjoys walks, though his Beagle nose occasionally leads him on little sniffing adventures. He rides great in the car, is doing wonderfully with pottying outside, and gets along well with his two foster Beagle sisters. Once he's comfortable in his surroundings, he loves to play and have fun.Because he can be nervous around unfamiliar people, particularly men, he'll need a patient family that understands trust takes time. He may initially growl when a man enters the room, but with gentle, calm interactions and patience, he continues to make progress and will even accept pets when he's feeling comfortable.If you're willing to let this sweet boy move at his own pace, you'll be rewarded with a devoted companion who just wants a person to call his own. can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Bud
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Hi, I’m Bud! I’m a 2-year-old American Akita mix, tipping the scales at 59 lbs of love. Life dealt me a rough hand when my last owner abandoned me, but some wonderful people took me in and gave me a fresh start. I’m getting settled in and I’m ready to find my forever home!A little about me: I’m neutered, up to date on my vaccines, and microchipped — my new humans took great care of me I LOVE playing catch and I’ll happily play with any toy you hand me I’m a total snuggle bug — I crave affection and just want to be near my people I do well with other dogs and love to play, though I’m still working on my manners around cats and cows (a fenced yard would help me stay out of trouble!) I’m currently learning leash manners with my harnessSince my current family is helping me heal, I’ll come to you with all my vet records, my microchip info, and even a Fi Mini GPS tracker, so you can always find me.I’m hoping to find my forever humans soon — the kind who’ll give me space to run, love to give, and patience while I learn the ropes. If you think we might be a match, please fill out an application today! Located in Hatley, Wisconsin.You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Frank fka Finch
fetch.bio: The name’s Frank, and I’ve got a lot of love to give. Whoever you are, wherever you came from — I’m glad you’re here. Dogs, cats, kids, strangers passing by? I don’t discriminate. My heart has room for everyone, and I mean that sincerely.My foster home keeps me busy. There’s a younger dog I tear around with from sunup to sundown, and an older guy who likes his personal space (I read the room — we’re cool). I’ve settled in well, which honestly doesn’t surprise me. I’m pretty adaptable.The indoor stuff? Handled. I’m fully kennel trained and can sleep in one no problem — though between you and me, cuddling is where I truly shine. I’ve also never once thought about crossing my foster home’s underground fence. Not my style. My recall is coming along nicely too, even if my brain occasionally goes on a little vacation without telling me.I am absolutely wild about kids. Playing, snuggling, following them from room to room — sign me up for all of it. Meeting new people gets me pretty fired up too, which means leash walks are still something we’re polishing together. I’ve got the enthusiasm, I just need a little guidance channeling it.If you want a dog who will love you loudly, loyally, and with his whole goofy heart — I think we’d make a pretty great team. *a side note about Frank: Frank was rescued with cherry eyes. He has had one surgery on them which has improved them but he does still have them. His vet says that another surgery wouldn’t really help and Frank isn’t bothered by the

fetch.name: Winston (Summit)
fetch.bio: Meet Winston, a handsome 1.5-year-old mixed breed pup weighing 76 pounds who is ready to find his forever family!Winston is playful, affectionate, and loyal, and his favorite place to be is right by his people — cuddling on the couch, relaxing at your feet, or joining you for an adventure. If you want a dog who loves being part of the family, Winston is your guy.This sweet boy is fully potty and crate trained. He knows basic commands like “sit,” is very food motivated, and is eager to learn more when treats are involved. Outside, he loves chasing a ball or roping you into a game of tug-of-war. He’s doing well on walks, though like many young dogs he can still pull on the leash from time to time.Winston gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is doing great in his foster home with cats — mostly ignoring them, with the occasional playful invite he backs off from if they’re not interested. He’s fantastic with kids and adults too. At 1.5, he’s still in his goofy teenage phase and can get a little too excited, but a quick reminder is all he needs to settle down.Active or laid-back, Winston is happy to match your pace — full of energy for adventures, but just as content cuddled up for a quiet evening. Loving, social, and fun, Winston is ready to bring smiles, snuggles, and loyalty into his new home!You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Panini
fetch.bio: Meet Panini This sweet 7-year-old mini goldendoodle spent her early years as a mama in a commercial breeding program — and now that her babies are all grown, it’s finally Panini’s turn to learn how to just be a dog and a beloved family member. She’s still learning what that means, and she’s doing beautifully. Panini is coming out of her shell more every day: she wags her tail when you talk to her in a silly baby voice, gives little kisses, and has decided the bed is exactly where she belongs. Fast movements and loud noises still startle her, so she’d do best in a calm, patient home — ideally one with another dog to show her the ropes. She’s watching and learning, and having a canine role model would mean the world to her. Panini settles into her kennel just fine when you’re away, but when you’re home, she wants to be right by your side (or curled up with her dog sibling). She’s still working on potty training, so a little consistency and a fenced yard will go a long way. And if you’ve got treats? You’ve got a friend for life. Panini isn’t looking for perfect — just patient. Could that be you? You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Bella

We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Cookie

I’m still learning to trust new people, and sometimes I clam up in unfamiliar situations—but I promise, if you believe in me like my foster mom does, I’ll show you my HUGE, dorky, lovable personality!I’m looking for a patient and understanding home that will continue helping me build confidence. In return, I’ll give you unconditional love, endless tail wags, and a lifetime of loyalty. Could you be the one to give me my happily ever after?Apply to adopt me today!You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

southwood.name: Adam *Diabetic, In Foster*
southwood.bio: Adam is a handsome senior gentleman that would love a forever home to relax, unwind, and receive lots of love and give it in return! Adam was brought to us as a stray, and we soon realized that Adam was dealing with unmanaged diabetes. Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs. This has gotten better now that his diabetes is managed, but he may always walk a little funny. Adam uses the litter box just fine and has no issues! He is an older gentleman though, and may need some minor help with grooming and brushing. Adam is so, so sweet and has so much love to give - please consider letting him into your heart and he will love you back tenfold!Less

southwood.name: Eyore/Winston
southwood.bio: Meet Winston!If you're looking for a best friend who knows how to have fun, Winston is your guy! This big, lovable goofball has a zest for life that's impossible not to smile about. Having a friend to do it with is a plus! When he is not making a splash, you will see him racing around the yard with his characteristic goofy grin, reminding everyone that life is too short not to engage in play. He would do best with older children and a family that can continue working with him with his manners. If you're ready for endless laughs, outdoor adventures, and a loyal companion who's always up for fun, Winston is waiting to meet you!Less
